admissions_overview.summary: Admission to universities in Tanzania is through the university's own application system, supported by the Tanzania Commission for Universities (TCU), which regulates and accredits universities and publishes the minimum entry guidelines and the list of approved programmes. Direct entry to a bachelor's degree normally needs the Certificate of Secondary Education Examination (CSEE, O-Level) and the Advanced Certificate of Secondary Education Examination (ACSEE, Form Six) with the principal passes that each programme asks for. Applicants with an equivalent diploma, such as an Ordinary Diploma with good results, can apply through the equivalent-qualification route. Applicants usually apply online through the Central Admission System or the university's own online application system, and may select several programmes. Check the current admission guidebook for exact subject requirements.
admissions_overview.notes: Application windows, the admission guidebook, the programmes on offer and the minimum requirements change every year. Check the TCU website and the admissions page of each university. Higher education loans for eligible students are handled separately by the Higher Education Students' Loans Board (HESLB).
